description.value: Fort Bowling Lanes is a long-established 5-pin bowling alley in Fort St. John, BC, serving the community for over 40 years with 12 lanes including themed 'Cosmic' bowling. The venue features a snack bar offering pizza, Mac & Cheese Bites, and Mini Donuts alongside a fully licensed lounge, and can accommodate up to 120 guests — making it one of Fort St. John's primary indoor social hubs. Touring cyclists passing through this Northern BC gateway city could stop for a meal, a drink, and a few frames in a wheelchair-accessible, community-oriented setting.
